svg.title: The lowest energy bill, fully automated
svg.desc: A modern house with a white upper floor, dark brick below, a garage on the left and solar panels on the flat roof. The battery and the heat pump are in the garage, the dishwasher in the kitchen and the rainwater tank under the front lawn. Home Assistant sends my own solar first to the house, the battery, the dishwasher and the boiler, buys from the grid in the cheapest quarter-hours, and curtails the panels only for what nobody can use.
svg.text: The lowest energy bill, fully automated.
Make as much solar as I can, use as much of it as I can, and buy the rest at the cheapest moment of the day.
reacts live to sun and price,
WHEN I BUY FROM THE GRID
Negative price: charge, heat, panels off
Works with Zendure · Ecoforest · Siemens · APsystems · HomeWizard · Shelly · Nordpool · Solcast
